observation_nodes.label: Professor Tealeaf
observation_nodes.description: A trusted contact at the Wizard’s College in Mirathorn whom the party chose to message about communication problems with the city.

observation_nodes.label: Grobnok
observation_nodes.description: A Mirathorn contact of the party who communicates by rockie-talkie, reports on the city’s worsening corruption outbreak, works with Tealeaf, and relays the council’s instructions to continue to the swamp.

observation_nodes.label: Private Hester
observation_nodes.description: A young mounted soldier of the Elderwild Reach carrying sealed reports for Mirathorn; she warns of mysterious music, people walking into the swamp, and advises Lysandra to speak to Commander Vale before entering.

observation_nodes.label: Commander Vale
observation_nodes.description: A commander whom Private Hester says Lysandra should speak to before the group heads into the swamp.

observation_nodes.label: Frank
observation_nodes.description: A Mirathorn contact from whom Grobnok took the rockie-talkie after Frank appeared to have been compromised.

observation_nodes.label: Sara
observation_nodes.description: A person in Mirathorn whom Grobnok reports he has not seen recently during the city’s crisis.

observation_nodes.label: Dustwalker
observation_nodes.description: A performer from the festival whose song Ephanna recognizes as matching the tune the group finds themselves humming.

observation_nodes.label: the Shepherd
observation_nodes.description: A figure for whom the 'meat heads' are openly recruiting in Mirathorn, indicating leadership or symbolic importance within the cult activity.

observation_nodes.label: Lysandro
observation_nodes.description: Lysandra’s father, encountered as a guard atop Mireward’s wall when the group arrives at night.

observation_nodes.label: the Reach
observation_nodes.description: A regional destination area the group turns their focus toward while traveling north.

observation_nodes.label: Golden Fields
observation_nodes.description: A vast region to the north associated with the Reach.

observation_nodes.label: Mireward
observation_nodes.description: The group's intended northern destination, later indicated as 20 miles north and reached near the end of the journey.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn
observation_nodes.description: A city south of the group's route, reachable by a multiday return journey and serving as a communications target and report destination.

observation_nodes.label: the swamp
observation_nodes.description: A named travel zone associated with mysterious music, people walking into it, and the believed origin point of the broader problem.

observation_nodes.label: Elderwild Reach
observation_nodes.description: A regional polity or territory identified by the soldier's uniform recognized by Stafl.

observation_nodes.label: fork in the road
observation_nodes.description: A road junction encountered before Mireward, marked by a sign indicating Mireward 20 miles north.

observation_nodes.label: abandoned restaurant
observation_nodes.description: A small roadside building at the fork in the road, recently abandoned and used by the group as shelter from a hail storm.

observation_nodes.label: small storage area
observation_nodes.description: A sublocation beneath the abandoned restaurant accessed by trapdoor.

observation_nodes.label: Elderwild Reach
observation_nodes.description: A regional authority or military-bearing polity with its own soldier uniforms, commanders, and reporting structure. Private Hester serves under it, and Stafl previously wore its uniform before joining the party.

observation_nodes.label: Wizard’s College
observation_nodes.description: An academic organization in or associated with Mirathorn that the party considers relatively trustworthy and less likely to be compromised.

observation_nodes.label: the council
observation_nodes.description: The governing council in Mirathorn, attempting to manage the outbreak crisis, directing the party onward to the swamp, and making emergency decisions such as hiring mercenaries after the city guard was reduced.

observation_nodes.label: city guard
observation_nodes.description: Mirathorn’s guard force, described as decimated and further reduced by corruption during the outbreak.

observation_nodes.label: mercenaries
observation_nodes.description: A hired armed group brought in by the council as a response to the weakened city guard; later described as existing in an uneasy truce with the "meat heads."

observation_nodes.label: the "meat heads"
observation_nodes.description: A named group in Mirathorn involved in an uneasy truce with the mercenaries and openly recruiting for the Shepherd.

observation_nodes.label: the Shepherd
observation_nodes.description: An apparent cult-centered faction for which the "meat heads" are recruiting; Lysandra states the mission is to destroy the source of the cult.

observation_nodes.label: Questionable Company
observation_nodes.description: The player party acting collectively as the traveling team focused on reaching the swamp and addressing the source of the threat.

observation_nodes.label: rockie-talkie
observation_nodes.description: A communication device the group uses to attempt contact with Mirathorn and later receive calls from Grobnok.

observation_nodes.label: silver raven
observation_nodes.description: A magical messenger item the group sends to carry spoken and written messages toward Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: wagon
observation_nodes.description: The party's wagon, used for travel and packing camp as they continue north toward Mireward.

observation_nodes.label: sealed tube
observation_nodes.description: A sealed report tube carried by Private Hester containing reports intended for Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Whisper Bottle
observation_nodes.description: Caelynn's item used as the focus or means for casting Detect Magic on the anomalous puddle water.

observation_nodes.label: vial of puddle water
observation_nodes.description: A small vial filled by Caelynn with water from the conjuration-tainted puddle for later examination; Identify suggests no one should drink it.

observation_nodes.label: stick
observation_nodes.description: A stick Karsemine uses to poke the anomalous puddle while investigating it.

observation_nodes.label: Mireward road sign
observation_nodes.description: A roadside sign at the fork indicating Mireward is 20 miles north.

observation_nodes.label: chalkboard menu
observation_nodes.description: A chalkboard outside the abandoned restaurant, hastily erased and rewritten to read 'headed south, north wrong'.

observation_nodes.label: trapdoor
observation_nodes.description: A trapdoor inside the abandoned restaurant leading to a small storage area.

observation_nodes.label: jar with skewers of old meat
observation_nodes.description: A jar found in the restaurant storage area containing a few skewers with old graying meat.

observation_nodes.label: Mirathorn communications failure and possible internal compromise
observation_nodes.description: The party repeatedly fails to contact Mirathorn normally, then learns that at least one trusted contact, Frank, appears compromised. Sara is missing from Grobnok's view, suggesting broader instability or infiltration within Mirathorn.

observation_nodes.label: Swamp believed to be the source of the wider corruption crisis
observation_nodes.description: Multiple reports point toward the swamp as the origin of the dangerous phenomenon affecting both the road and Mirathorn. The council explicitly directs the group to continue there because they believe the problem originates in the swamp.

observation_nodes.label: Mysterious music luring people into the swamp
observation_nodes.description: Private Hester reports mysterious music and people walking into the swamp without responding when stopped. Later, the party involuntarily hums the same song associated with the Dustwalker performance, suggesting a spreading auditory compulsion or influence.

observation_nodes.label: Roadside puddles show delayed reflections
observation_nodes.description: Karsemine observes that reflections in shimmering puddles lag by about a second, indicating reality distortion or magical interference along the road.

observation_nodes.label: Puddle phenomenon is conjuration linked to planar bleed
observation_nodes.description: Caelynn detects conjuration magic in the puddle, and later Stafl's identification and arcane analysis suggest the substance is bleed from another plane of existence being conjured into the area.

observation_nodes.label: Puddle sample is unsafe to ingest
observation_nodes.description: Stafl cannot fully identify the vial's contents but determines that no one should drink it, implying the conjured planar substance is hazardous.

observation_nodes.label: Concern that planar bleed will affect local flora and fauna
observation_nodes.description: After determining the puddle magic may be planar bleed, the group becomes concerned about harmful effects on plants and animals in the region.

observation_nodes.label: Grobnok reports renewed outbreak and worsening city conditions
observation_nodes.description: Grobnok reports that corrupted meat was not contained in time, leading to a full outbreak again. The city guard is diminished, mercenaries have been hired, and he and Professor Tealeaf are attempting to maintain control.

observation_nodes.label: Shimmering-eye corruption now affects a gnome
observation_nodes.description: Grobnok reports that a gnome within the city was found with shimmering eyes, despite this previously only occurring in infected humans. This implies the corruption is spreading across species or categories previously thought exempt.

observation_nodes.label: Rhythmic sound heard on the wind from the north
observation_nodes.description: During Karsemine's watch, she hears a rhythmic sound carried on the wind from the north. This later appears connected to the shared humming experienced by the group.

observation_nodes.label: Strange mist with a familiar savory flavor
observation_nodes.description: At dawn, Ephanna encounters a rising mist with a familiar savory flavor, suggesting another manifestation tied to the meat corruption or related magical contamination.

observation_nodes.label: Converging storms create unnatural severe weather
observation_nodes.description: Storms from different directions appear to merge, creating a looming sense of danger and culminating in a massive hail storm. The weather pattern may be linked to the broader magical disturbances affecting the region.

observation_nodes.label: Abandoned roadside restaurant warns 'north wrong'
observation_nodes.description: A recently abandoned restaurant contains a hastily altered sign reading 'headed south, north wrong,' implying travelers fled the northern route and believed danger lay ahead toward Mireward or the swamp.

observation_nodes.label: Unexplained knocking sound with no visible source
observation_nodes.description: After the hail storm, Karsemine hears unmistakable knocking on a door, but scouting reveals no source and nothing nearby that should have a door.

observation_nodes.label: Warning to consult Commander Vale before entering the swamp
observation_nodes.description: Private Hester explicitly warns Lysandra to speak to Commander Vale before heading into the swamp, implying local military knowledge, danger escalation, or necessary authorization.

observation_nodes.label: Lysandra states her true intention is to keep the team focused on destroying the swamp source
observation_nodes.description: Under Suggestion, Lysandra says her goal is to keep the team focused on going to the swamp and destroying the cult's source. This partially clarifies her motivations, though trust issues remain within the group.

ignored_items.label: Bonogo jumps into the puddle and nothing immediately happens
ignored_items.reason: This is a negative test result with no immediate new mystery beyond confirming no obvious instant transformation from contact alone.

ignored_items.label: Pair of eyes during watch turns out to be a fox
ignored_items.reason: Explicitly resolved as mundane and not part of the anomalous thread.

ignored_items.label: Guard is revealed to be Lysandra's father Lysandro
ignored_items.reason: Character relationship reveal rather than a mystery/clue/warning/thread for this extraction pass.

deferred_items.label: Connection between the Dustwalker festival song and current compulsion effects
deferred_items.reason: Strongly implied but not yet explained; needs corroborating evidence from prior or later sessions to determine mechanism and source.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Review earlier Dustwalker festival scenes and subsequent Mireward/swamp encounters for direct references tying the song to compulsion or cult activity.

deferred_items.label: The Shepherd's growing open recruitment in Mirathorn
deferred_items.reason: Important cult escalation, but this pass is focused on mysteries and road-to-swamp phenomena; broader faction-state tracking may belong in a separate political or cult activity extraction.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Cross-reference prior and later city reports to build a dedicated thread for the Shepherd's recruitment, influence, and organizational structure.

observation_beats.title: Party breaks camp and weighs route toward the Reach
observation_beats.summary: The group turns its attention north toward the Reach and Mireward, with Mirathorn remaining a multiday retreat option. They break camp amid damp, magically sheened terrain while storms gather from the west.

observation_beats.title: Failed contact attempt leads to messages for Tealeaf and Grobnok
observation_beats.summary: After failing again to reach Mirathorn by rockie-talkie, the group plans alternative communication. They send a silver raven with messages intended for Professor Tealeaf and an encoded note for Grobnok asking for trusted contact back from the city.

observation_beats.title: Northward travel reveals delayed reflections in puddles
observation_beats.summary: The group resumes travel north under converging storms. During quiet travel and tense conversation, Karsemine notices puddle reflections lagging behind reality by about a second.

observation_beats.title: Private Hester brings alarming reports from the swamp
observation_beats.summary: A mounted Elderwild Reach soldier, Private Hester, intercepts the group while carrying sealed reports for Mirathorn. She reports mysterious music and people walking into the swamp without responding, reacts with alarm to the group's mention of glassy-eyed victims, and advises Lysandra to speak with Commander Vale before entering the swamp.

observation_beats.title: Magical puddle is tested and sampled
observation_beats.summary: While seeking camp, Karsemine and Caelynn investigate the strange puddles. Detect Magic suggests conjuration magic in the puddle, Caelynn collects a vial, and Bonogo's sudden leap into the water causes no immediate visible effect.

observation_beats.title: Camp analysis and Grobnok's grim city update
observation_beats.summary: At camp, Identify reveals little about the vial except that it should not be consumed, and further arcane examination suggests planar bleed being conjured into the area. Grobnok then reaches them by rockie-talkie with dire news: Frank appears compromised, Sara is missing from his view, corruption has reignited in Mirathorn, mercenaries have been hired, and the council wants the party to continue toward the swamp while Grobnok becomes their sole contact.

observation_beats.title: Night watches bring strange sounds and signs of a major hailstorm
observation_beats.summary: The night is mostly quiet except for gnats, a rhythmic sound from the north during Karsemine's watch, and a savory mist at dawn. With no morning call from Grobnok, the group resumes travel as Caelynn identifies the convergence of storms as a huge incoming hailstorm and urges the group to seek shelter.

observation_beats.title: Improved morale, Lysandra's doubts, and shared humming on the road
observation_beats.summary: Travel improves the party's mood, and Lysandra confides to Ephanna that she feels she is handling her mission poorly but wants to reclaim leadership. Soon every member realizes they are all humming the same tune, which Karsemine and Ephanna connect to the night's rhythm and the Dustwalker's festival song, just as they reach a fork marked Mireward twenty miles north.

observation_beats.title: Abandoned roadside restaurant offers warning and shelter from hail
observation_beats.summary: At the fork, the group inspects a recently abandoned restaurant whose erased message now warns that north is wrong and that others headed south. Finding little inside besides old graying meat, they decide to shelter there, reinforce the building, and endure a violent hailstorm that soon passes.

observation_beats.title: After the storm, an unexplained knocking follows the group
observation_beats.summary: Believing they can still reach Mireward that night, the group departs after assessing storm damage. Soon Karsemine hears what sounds like knocking on a door, but despite scouting cannot locate either the source or any actual door nearby.

observation_beats.title: Grobnok reports worsening unrest and broader corruption in Mirathorn
observation_beats.summary: Another call from Grobnok describes worsening conditions in the city: a tense truce between mercenaries and 'meat heads,' more open recruitment for the Shepherd, and a shocking case of shimmering eyes in a gnome rather than only infected humans. Stafl reacts angrily, ending the call and demonstrating distrust over who should hold the rockie-talkie.

observation_beats.title: Stafl magically probes Lysandra before the group reaches Mireward's wall
observation_beats.summary: Stafl casts Suggestion on Lysandra to compel an answer about her true intentions, and she states that she wants to keep the team focused on reaching the swamp and destroying the cult's source. Later, near night, the party reaches a walled settlement where a guard challenges them and Bonogo accidentally steps forward when Karsemine asks for their leader to do so.

observation_beats.title: Guard recognizes Lysandra and introduces Lysandro
observation_beats.summary: The guard identifies Lysandra as his daughter, and she corrects him by rank before the party meets her father, Lysandro.
